labels.why: restoreProfileXml sets admin from the last <admin> element of client-submitted XML. The signature check is no barrier because exportProfileXml writes bio unescaped, so a bio of </bio><admin>true</admin><bio> yields a validly signed export that makes the caller admin. This is the export/restore challenge, not the import endpoint the answer key names.
